cli.hub_org.ineligible.note: The ONLY sentence shown to an ineligible account: a direct answer, never an up-sell. `Radient Team` is a plan name; keep it verbatim

cli.hub_org.choose_org.note: followed by a list of organizations; --org is a flag token

cli.hub_org.resolved.note: {ref} is what the user typed, {hub_id} an identifier; the arrow stays

cli.hub_org.ambiguous.note: followed by candidate lines; {ref} is user input

cli.hub_org.not_found.note: {org} is a tenant id, {ref} user input

cli.hub_org.unlinked_copies.note: {names} is a comma-separated list of item names; the backticked command stays verbatim

cli.hub_org.plan.note: dry-run summary; --yes is a flag token

cli.hub_org.adopted_heading.note: heading over lines `kind name: result (backup path)`

cli.hub_org.last_enrol.note: {at} is a local date and time (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM) of the last automatic sync

cli.hub_org.list_failed.note: {kind} is agent/team/skill (identifier), {cause} a server error line

cli.hub_org.ineligible_signed_out.note: The ONLY sentence shown to a signed-out user: a direct answer, never an up-sell. `Radient Team` is a plan name; `lop login radient` is a command, keep both verbatim. Sibling of cli.hub_org.ineligible (signed in, no team plan)

cli.hub_org.unknown_org.note: followed by a list of the user's eligible organizations; {ref} is what the user passed to --org (a name or tenant id); --org is a flag token

cli.hub_org.plan_empty.note: dry-run summary when nothing is left to pull: every organization item is already linked on this machine

cli.hub_org.team_block_heading.note: title of a box-drawn block listing one organization's teams after the public results in `lop teams search`; {org} is the organization's name (data). Keep it short: it sits inside a one-line tree frame
